definitions.gloss: falling object; fallen debris; dropped item
definitions.explanation: An object that has fallen or may fall from a height. Commonly used in safety warnings, traffic reports, and construction contexts.

examples.japanese: {落下物|らっかぶつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧。
⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{落下物|らっかぶつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was fallen debris on the highway.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}{現場|げんば}→工事現場：26202_koujigenba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{落下物|らっかぶつ}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦ヘルメット→ヘルメット：11325_herumetto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{着用|ちゃくよう}→着用：13693_chakuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧づけられて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: At construction sites, wearing helmets is mandatory to prevent accidents from falling objects.

notes:
Commonly seen on highway signs, construction site warnings, and safety notices. A compound of ⟦{落下|らっか}→落下：14051_rakka⟧ (falling) and ⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧ (object).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {落下物|らっかぶつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧: caution for falling objects
- {落下物|らっかぶつ}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧: falling object accident
- {落下物|らっかぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回避|かいひ}する→回避する：17014_kaihisuru⟧: to avoid a falling object
- ⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{落下物|らっかぶつ}: debris on the road

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{落下|らっか}→落下：14051_rakka⟧: falling; dropping — the act of falling itself
- {落石|らくせき}: falling rocks; rockfall — specifically rocks falling on roads or mountainsides
- {飛来物|ひらいぶつ}: flying object; airborne debris — objects carried by wind or an explosion
